name: superpowers-manager
description: Install obra/superpowers directly from upstream for Codex, Pi, and OpenCode. Stay on a known-good release or commit, try a branch, and upgrade when you choose.

scripts.prepack: node --input-type=module -e "console.error('error: use node tests/tools/pack.ts --out-dir <directory> to package this checkout');process.exitCode=1"
scripts.lint: oxlint src/ tests/bin/ tests/unit/ tests/baseline/ tests/lib/ tests/tools/ tests/container/ tests/run-node-suites.ts tests/assert-matcher-gate.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src/ tests/bin/ tests/unit/ tests/baseline/ tests/lib/ tests/tools/ tests/container/ tests/run-node-suites.ts tests/assert-matcher-gate.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/ tests/bin/ tests/unit/ tests/baseline/ tests/lib/ tests/tools/ tests/container/ tests/run-node-suites.ts tests/assert-matcher-gate.ts
scripts.check:static: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip
scripts.check: pnpm run check:static && pnpm run test
